legacy_rows.Eligibility / restrictions: Participating degrees including Computing and Health and Social Care
legacy_rows.Delivery / credit / practical activity: Short placement or professional project, preparation workshops and reflective assessment. 15 credits: optional in Data Science and Computing; compulsory in the named Health and Social Care route.
legacy_rows.Basis for reach classification: Two programme specifications establish cross-faculty use, not availability on every degree.

legacy_rows.Eligibility / restrictions: Birkbeck students and graduates interested in enterprise
legacy_rows.Delivery / credit / practical activity: Extracurricular workshops, founder guidance and business development alongside study. Current programme page sets an October 2026 selection timetable.
